local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui          = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local TweenService     = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer      = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera           = workspace.CurrentCamera

local TARGET_GAME_ID = 84448037861644
local TITLE_ICON     = "rbxassetid://81470350553607"
local DISCORD_LINK   = "https://discord.gg/KSATpcU2Cn"
local LOADER_BRAND   = "NEMESIS"

local Config = {
    Silent = {
        Enabled     = false,
        UseFOV      = true,
        MaxDistance = 350,
        TeamCheck   = true,
        WallCheck   = false,
        Part        = "Head",
        HitChance   = 100,
        FOV         = 130,
    },
}

local Theme = {
    Bg      = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12),
    Panel   = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22),
    Row     = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34),
    Accent  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    Text    = Color3.fromRGB(245, 240, 250),
    TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(150, 140, 165),
    Off     = Color3.fromRGB(45, 40, 50),
    Green   = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120),
    Red     = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
    Discord = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242),
}

local function getAimPart(char, partName)
    partName = partName or "Head"
    if partName == "HumanoidRootPart" then
        return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    elseif partName == "UpperTorso" then
        return char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Head")
end

local function silentVisibilityCheck(part, char)
    if not Config.Silent.WallCheck then return true end
    local filter = { LocalPlayer.Character }
    if char then table.insert(filter, char) end
    local rp = RaycastParams.new()
    rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, rp)
    return result == nil
end

local function getSilentTarget()
    if not Config.Silent.Enabled then return nil end
    local chance = Config.Silent.HitChance or 100
    if chance < 100 and math.random(1, 100) > chance then return nil end

    local closest, best = nil, Config.Silent.UseFOV and Config.Silent.FOV or math.huge
    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, Camera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local maxDist = Config.Silent.MaxDistance or 350

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local skip = false
            if Config.Silent.TeamCheck and plr.Team and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
                skip = true
            end
            if not skip then
                local char = plr.Character
                if char then
                    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                        local part = getAimPart(char, Config.Silent.Part)
                        if part then
                            local dist3d = (part.Position - camPos).Magnitude
                            if dist3d <= maxDist then
                                local screen, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                                if onScreen and screen.Z > 0 then
                                    local dist = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
                                    if (not Config.Silent.UseFOV or dist <= Config.Silent.FOV) and dist < best then
                                        if silentVisibilityCheck(part, char) then
                                            closest = part
                                            best = dist
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local silentHooked = false
local silentOldNamecall = nil
local function ensureSilentHook()
    if silentHooked then return true end
    if type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then
        return false
    end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        silentOldNamecall = hookmetamethod(Camera, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
            local method = getnamecallmethod()
            if (method == "ViewportPointToRay" or method == "ScreenPointToRay")
                and self == Camera and Config.Silent.Enabled then
                local okTarget, target = pcall(getSilentTarget)
                if okTarget and target and target.Parent then
                    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
                    local ox = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06
                    local oy = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05
                    local oz = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06
                    local aimPos = target.Position + Vector3.new(ox, oy, oz)
                    return Ray.new(origin, (aimPos - origin).Unit * 1000)
                end
            end
            return silentOldNamecall(self, ...)
        end)
    end)
    if ok then
        silentHooked = true
        return true
    end
    return false
end

pcall(function()
    local function nuke(parent)
        for _, g in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
            if g.Name == "SilentAimOpenSourceMini" or g.Name == "NemesisLoader" then
                g:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    nuke(CoreGui)
    if gethui then pcall(function() nuke(gethui()) end) end
end)

local function parentGui(g)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        if gethui then g.Parent = gethui() else g.Parent = CoreGui end
    end)
    if not ok then g.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
end

local function toInt(v)
    if type(v) == "number" then return math.floor(v) end
    if type(v) == "string" then
        local n = tonumber(v)
        if n then return math.floor(n) end
    end
    local ok, n = pcall(function() return tonumber(tostring(v)) end)
    if ok and n then return math.floor(n) end
    return nil
end

local rawGameId  = game.GameId
local rawPlaceId = game.PlaceId
local gameIdNum  = toInt(rawGameId)
local placeIdNum = toInt(rawPlaceId)
local targetNum  = toInt(TARGET_GAME_ID)

print("[NEMESIS] GameId  =", tostring(rawGameId), "->", tostring(gameIdNum))
print("[NEMESIS] PlaceId =", tostring(rawPlaceId), "->", tostring(placeIdNum))
print("[NEMESIS] Target  =", tostring(TARGET_GAME_ID), "->", tostring(targetNum))

local function matchesTarget()
    if gameIdNum and targetNum and gameIdNum == targetNum then return true end
    if placeIdNum and targetNum and placeIdNum == targetNum then return true end
    local gs = tostring(rawGameId):gsub("%D", "")
    local ps = tostring(rawPlaceId):gsub("%D", "")
    local ts = tostring(TARGET_GAME_ID):gsub("%D", "")
    if gs == ts or ps == ts then return true end
    return false
end

    local dragging, startInputPos, startFramePos
    local function beginDrag(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging = true
        startInputPos = input.Position
        startFramePos = Main.Position
    end
    local function updateDrag(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local delta = input.Position - startInputPos
        Main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startFramePos.X.Scale, startFramePos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startFramePos.Y.Scale, startFramePos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
    local function endDrag(input)
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
    end
    Header.InputBegan:Connect(beginDrag)
    Header.InputChanged:Connect(updateDrag)
    Header.InputEnded:Connect(endDrag)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(updateDrag)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(endDrag)

	{"ImageButton", "ImageTransparency"},
	{"ScrollingFrame", "ScrollBarImageTransparency"},
	{"UIStroke", "Transparency"},
	{"UIShadow", "Transparency"},
}

local originals = {}
local fadeExclude = {}

local function getOriginal(inst)
	local o = originals[inst]
	if o then
		return o
	end
	o = {}
	for _, pair in ipairs(fadeProps) do
		local okIs, is = pcall(inst.IsA, inst, pair[1])
		if okIs and is then
			local ok, v = pcall(function()
				return inst[pair[2]]
			end)
			if ok and type(v) == "number" then
				o[pair[2]] = v
			end
		end
	end
	originals[inst] = o
	inst.Destroying:Connect(function()
		originals[inst] = nil
	end)
	return o
end

local function isExcluded(inst)
	for _, root in ipairs(fadeExclude) do
		if inst == root or inst:IsDescendantOf(root) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function fade(root, alpha, t)
	local list = root:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(list, root)
	for _, inst in ipairs(list) do
		if not isExcluded(inst) then
			local goal
			for prop, v in pairs(getOriginal(inst)) do
				goal = goal or {}
				goal[prop] = v + (1 - v) * (1 - alpha)
			end
			if goal then
				if t and t > 0 then
					tween(inst, t, goal, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				else
					for p, v in pairs(goal) do
						pcall(function()
							inst[p] = v
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local glyphs = "!<>-_\\/[]{}=+*^?#@$%&"
local scrambleIds = {}

local function scramble(lbl, text, duration)
	local id = (scrambleIds[lbl] or 0) + 1
	scrambleIds[lbl] = id
	task.spawn(function()
		local start, len = os.clock(), #text
		while lbl.Parent and scrambleIds[lbl] == id do
			local p = (os.clock() - start) / duration
			if p >= 1 then
				break
			end
			local revealed = math.floor(p * len)
			local out = table.create(len)
			for i = 1, len do
				local ch = text:sub(i, i)
				if i <= revealed or ch == " " then
					out[i] = ch
				else
					local r = math.random(1, #glyphs)
					out[i] = glyphs:sub(r, r)
				end
			end
			lbl.Text = table.concat(out)
			task.wait(0.03)
		end
		if scrambleIds[lbl] == id then
			lbl.Text = text
		end
	end)
end

local function applySearch()
	local query = SearchBox.Text:lower()
	local keywords = {}
	for word in string.gmatch(query, "%S+") do
		table.insert(keywords, word)
	end
	
	local anyVisible = false
	for _, child in ipairs(GamepassList:GetChildren()) do
		if child:GetAttribute("IsRow") then
			local title = child:FindFirstChild("Title")
			local sub = child:FindFirstChild("Sub")
			local id = child:GetAttribute("Id")
			
			local textToSearch = ""
			if title then textToSearch = textToSearch .. title.Text:lower() .. " " end
			if sub then textToSearch = textToSearch .. sub.Text:lower() .. " " end
			if id then textToSearch = textToSearch .. tostring(id):lower() end
			
			local match = true
			if #keywords > 0 then
				for _, kw in ipairs(keywords) do
					if not string.find(textToSearch, kw, 1, true) then
						match = false
						break
					end
				end
			end
			
			if match then
				child.Visible = true
				anyVisible = true
				child:SetAttribute("IsMatch", true)
				child.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 75, 45)
				child.LayoutOrder = -1000 + (child:GetAttribute("BaseOrder") or 0)
			else

				child:SetAttribute("IsMatch", false)
				child.BackgroundColor3 = col.panel
				child.LayoutOrder = child:GetAttribute("BaseOrder") or 0
			end
		end
	end
	
	local empty = emptyLabels[GamepassList]
	if empty then
		empty.Visible = not anyVisible
	end
end

		return

	local s = MainScale.Scale > 0 and MainScale.Scale or 1
	local x = (btn.AbsolutePosition.X + btn.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 - BottomBar.AbsolutePosition.X) / s
	local pos = UDim2.new(0, x, 1, -2)
	if instant then

	end

local function setTab(index, instant)
	if index == currentTab then
		return
	end
	local prev = currentTab
	local dir = (prev and index < prev) and -1 or 1
	currentTab = index

	for i, tab in ipairs(tabs) do
		local goal = i == index and navActive or idle
		if instant then
			for k, v in pairs(goal) do
				tab.button[k] = v
			end
		else
			tween(tab.button, 0.2, goal)
		end
	end
	moveIndicator(instant)

	if prev then
		local old = tabs[prev].screen
		if instant then
			old.Visible = false
		else
			fade(old, 0, 0.15)
			tween(old, 0.25, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.06 * dir, 0)})
			task.delay(0.25, function()
				if tabs[currentTab].screen ~= old then
					old.Visible = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local screen = tabs[index].screen
	screen.Visible = true
	if instant then
		screen.Position = UDim2.new()
		fade(screen, 1, 0)
	else
		screen.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06 * dir, 0)
		fade(screen, 0, 0)
		tween(screen, 0.4, {Position = UDim2.new()})
		fade(screen, 1, 0.3)
	end
end

local ascii = {}
do
	local font = Enum.Font.Code
	local huge = Vector2.new(1e5, 1e5)
	local size = asciiCfg.textSize

	local cw = TextService:GetTextSize(string.rep("M", 40), size, font, huge).X / 40
	local h1 = TextService:GetTextSize("M", size, font, huge).Y
	local h11 = TextService:GetTextSize(string.rep("M\n", 10) .. "M", size, font, huge).Y
	local ch = (h11 - h1) / 10
	if cw <= 0 then
		cw = size * 0.6
	end
	if ch <= 0 then
		ch = size
	end

	local layers = {
		{min = 0.1, transparency = 0.84},
		{min = 0.4, transparency = 0.62},
		{min = 0.7, transparency = 0.3},
	}

	local labels = {}
	for i in ipairs(layers) do
		labels[i] = create("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Layer" .. i,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Font = font,
			TextSize = size,
			TextColor3 = asciiCfg.color,
			TextTransparency = 1,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
			TextWrapped = false,
			RichText = false,
			Text = "",
			ZIndex = 1,
			Parent = AsciiHolder,
		})
	end

	local ramp = {}
	for i = 1, #asciiCfg.ramp do
		ramp[i] = asciiCfg.ramp:sub(i, i)
	end
	local rampLen = #ramp

	local cols, rows, offX, offY = 0, 0, 0, 0
	local glow = {}
	local bufs = {{}, {}, {}}
	local lines = {{}, {}, {}}

	function ascii.rebuild(area, inner)
		cols = math.max(1, math.floor(area.X / cw))
		rows = math.max(1, math.floor(area.Y / ch))
		offX = (area.X - cols * cw) / 2
		offY = (area.Y - rows * ch) / 2

		for _, l in ipairs(labels) do
			l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(offX, offY)
			l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cols * cw + 4, rows * ch + 4)
		end

		local cx, cy = area.X / 2, area.Y / 2
		local hw, hh = inner.X / 2, inner.Y / 2
		local pad = asciiCfg.padding
		table.clear(glow)
		for y = 0, rows - 1 do
			local qy = math.max(math.abs(offY + (y + 0.5) * ch - cy) - hh, 0)
			for x = 0, cols - 1 do
				local qx = math.max(math.abs(offX + (x + 0.5) * cw - cx) - hw, 0)
				local i = y * cols + x + 1
				if qx == 0 and qy == 0 then
					glow[i] = -1
				else
					local g = math.clamp(1 - math.sqrt(qx * qx + qy * qy) / pad, 0, 1)
					glow[i] = g * g * (3 - 2 * g)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(bufs) do
			table.clear(b)
		end
	end

	local noise, sin, cos, sqrt, exp, floor = math.noise, math.sin, math.cos, math.sqrt, math.exp, math.floor
	local min1, min2, min3 = layers[1].min, layers[2].min, layers[3].min
	local aspect = ch / cw

	function ascii.render(t, alpha, mx, my)
		local mcx, mcy
		if mx then
			mcx, mcy = (mx - offX) / cw, (my - offY) / ch
		end
		local b1, b2, b3 = bufs[1], bufs[2], bufs[3]
		local l1, l2, l3 = lines[1], lines[2], lines[3]

		for y = 0, rows - 1 do
			local base = y * cols
			local ny = y * 0.11 - t * 0.35
			local wy = cos(y * 0.21 - t * 0.7)
			for x = 0, cols - 1 do
				local g = glow[base + x + 1]
				local c1, c2, c3 = " ", " ", " "
				if g > 0 then
					local v = 0.45 + noise(x * 0.055, ny, t * 0.12) * 1.3 + sin(x * 0.12 + t * 1.1) * wy * 0.18
					if mcx then
						local dx, dy = x - mcx, (y - mcy) * aspect
						local d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
						v += sin(d * 0.45 - t * 7) * exp(-d * 0.09) * 0.45
					end
					v *= g * alpha
					if v >= min1 then
						local idx = math.clamp(floor(v * rampLen) + 1, 2, rampLen)
						local glyph = ramp[idx]
						if v >= min3 then
							c3 = glyph
						elseif v >= min2 then
							c2 = glyph
						else
							c1 = glyph
						end
					end
				end
				b1[x + 1], b2[x + 1], b3[x + 1] = c1, c2, c3
			end
			l1[y + 1] = table.concat(b1, "", 1, cols)
			l2[y + 1] = table.concat(b2, "", 1, cols)
			l3[y + 1] = table.concat(b3, "", 1, cols)
		end

		labels[1].Text = table.concat(l1, "\n", 1, rows)
		labels[2].Text = table.concat(l2, "\n", 1, rows)
		labels[3].Text = table.concat(l3, "\n", 1, rows)

		for i, layer in ipairs(layers) do
			labels[i].TextTransparency = 1 - (1 - layer.transparency) * alpha
		end
	end
end

local asciiAlpha = Instance.new("NumberValue")

do
	local acc, lastArea = 0, nil
	local start = os.clock()

	bind(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
		AsciiHolder.Position = Main.Position
		if not asciiCfg.enabled then
			return
		end

		local alpha = asciiAlpha.Value
		if alpha <= 0.001 then
			return
		end

		acc += dt
		if acc < 1 / asciiCfg.fps then
			return
		end
		acc = 0

		local s = MainScale.Scale > 0 and MainScale.Scale or 1
		local abs = Main.AbsoluteSize
		local inner = Vector2.new(math.floor(abs.X / s + 0.5), math.floor(abs.Y / s + 0.5))
		local area = inner + Vector2.new(asciiCfg.padding * 2, asciiCfg.padding * 2)
		if area ~= lastArea then
			lastArea = area
			AsciiHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(area.X, area.Y)
			ascii.rebuild(area, inner)
		end

		local mx, my
		if asciiCfg.mouse then
			local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - AsciiHolder.AbsolutePosition
			if m.X >= 0 and m.Y >= 0 and m.X <= area.X and m.Y <= area.Y then
				mx, my = m.X, m.Y
			end
		end

		ascii.render(os.clock() - start, alpha, mx, my)
	end)
end

			callback()
		end
		return
	end
	isOpen = false
	tween(MainScale, 0.25, {Scale = 0.9}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
	fade(Main, 0, 0.22)
	tween(asciiAlpha, 0.35, {Value = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
	task.delay(0.36, function()
		if not isOpen then
			Main.Visible = false
			AsciiHolder.Visible = false
		end
		if callback then
			callback()
		end
	end)
end

function UI.Toggle()
	if destroyed then
		return
	end
	if isOpen then
		hide()
	else
		open()
	end
end

function UI.Destroy(instant)
	if destroyed then
		return
	end
	destroyed = true
	local function finish()
		for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
			c:Disconnect()
		end
		asciiAlpha:Destroy()
		ScreenGui:Destroy()
		if env.__ProductFaker == UI then
			env.__ProductFaker = nil
		end
	end
	if instant then
		finish()
	else
		hide(finish)
	end
end

	local known = knownKinds[tostring(id)]

	for _, kind in ipairs({"Product", "Gamepass", "Asset"}) do

			knownKinds[tostring(id)] = kind
			return kind
		end
	end
	return "Product"
end

local function getJson(url)
	local body
	if httpRequest then
		local ok, res = pcall(httpRequest, {Url = url, Method = "GET"})
		if ok and type(res) == "table" and (res.StatusCode == 200 or (res.StatusCode == nil and res.Success)) then
			body = res.Body
		end
	end
	if not body then
		local ok, res = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(url)
		end)
		if ok then
			body = res
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, body)
	return ok and data or nil
end

local function fetchGamepasses(universeId)
	for _, source in ipairs(passSources) do
		for _, host in ipairs(source.hosts) do
			local all, cursor = source.parse(getJson(source.url(host, universeId)))
			if all then
				local pages = 1
				while cursor and pages < 25 do
					local more, nextCursor = source.parse(getJson(source.url(host, universeId, cursor)))
					if not more then
						break
					end
					for _, p in ipairs(more) do
						table.insert(all, p)
					end
					cursor, pages = nextCursor, pages + 1
				end
				return all
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function logPrompt(kind, id)
	if destroyed or id == nil then
		return
	end
	local key = kind .. ":" .. tostring(id)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastPrompt[key] and now - lastPrompt[key] < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	lastPrompt[key] = now

	task.spawn(function()
		local info = getInfo(kind, id)
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		pendingRows[key] = addLog({
			id = id,
			kind = kind,
			name = info and (info.Name or info.DisplayName),
			price = info and (info.PriceInRobux or info.Price),
			icon = iconFor(kind, id, info),
		})
		if not ProductLogger.Visible then
			toast(("Logged %s %s"):format(kind:lower(), tostring(id)))
		end
	end)
end

local function firstId(...)
	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		local v = select(i, ...)
		if type(v) == "number" or (type(v) == "string" and v ~= "") then
			return v
		end
	end
end

local function lastBool(...)
	for i = select("#", ...), 1, -1 do
		local v = select(i, ...)
		if type(v) == "boolean" then
			return v
		end
	end
	return false
end

			logPrompt(kind, firstId(...))
		end)
	end)
	if ok then

	end
	pcall(function()
		bind(MarketplaceService["Prompt" .. suffix .. "Finished"], function(_, ...)

		end)
	end)

if hooked == 0 and typeof(hookmetamethod) == "function" and typeof(getnamecallmethod) == "function" then
	local old
	local function handler(self, ...)
		local method = getnamecallmethod()
		if not destroyed and self == MarketplaceService and method:sub(1, 6) == "Prompt" then
			local kind = promptKinds[method:sub(7)]
			if kind then
				task.spawn(logPrompt, kind, select(2, ...))
			end
		end
		return old(self, ...)
	end
	pcall(function()
		old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", typeof(newcclosure) == "function" and newcclosure(handler) or handler)
	end)
end

	for _, host in ipairs(hosts) do

	if placeId == game.PlaceId and game.GameId ~= 0 then
		return game.GameId
	end
	if universeCache[placeId] then
		return universeCache[placeId]
	end
	local d = getFromHosts("/universes/v1/places/" .. placeId .. "/universe", {"apis.roblox.com", "apis.roproxy.com"})
	local id = d and tonumber(d.universeId)
	universeCache[placeId] = id
	return id
end

local function getGameStats(universeIds)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #universeIds, 50 do
		local chunk = table.concat(universeIds, ",", i, math.min(i + 49, #universeIds))
		local d = getFromHosts("/v1/games?universeIds=" .. chunk, {"games.roblox.com", "games.roproxy.com"})
		if d and type(d.data) == "table" then
			for _, g in ipairs(d.data) do
				out[tonumber(g.id)] = g
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

    end
    return fists
end

local function firePunch()
    local fists = getFists()
    if fists then
        local innEvent = fists:FindFirstChild("inn")
        if innEvent then
            pcall(function() innEvent:FireServer(moveName) end)
        end
    end
end

local function executePunchWithRadius()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart

    local boxCFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -hitboxRadius.Z / 2)
    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}

    local partsInBox = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, hitboxRadius, overlapParams)
    local playersHit = {}

    for _, part in ipairs(partsInBox) do
        local model = part.Parent
        if model then
            local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if player and player ~= LocalPlayer and not playersHit[player] then
                playersHit[player] = true
                local fists = getFists()
                if fists and fists:FindFirstChild("inn") then
                    pcall(function() fists.inn:FireServer(moveName, player) end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if next(playersHit) == nil then
        firePunch()
    end
end

local function removeBlur()
    for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("BlurEffect") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if playerGui then
        local screenEffects = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ScreenEffects")
        if screenEffects then
            screenEffects.Enabled = false
        end

        for _, gui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
            if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and (gui.Name:lower():find("blur") or gui.Name:lower():find("static")) then
                gui.Enabled = false
            end
        end
    end
end

local function rejoinSameServer()
    if hasTriggered then return end
    hasTriggered = true
    pcall(function()
        TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, LocalPlayer)
    end)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
        isHoldingR = true
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            frozenPosition = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        end
        local fists = getFists()
        if fists and fists:FindFirstChild("move") then
            fists.move.Disabled = true
        end
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
        isHoldingR = false
        frozenPosition = nil
        local fists = getFists()
        if fists and fists:FindFirstChild("move") then
            fists.move.Disabled = false
        end
    end
end)

local function createRadiusVisual()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end

    local visual = Instance.new("Part")
    visual.Name = "PunchRadiusVisual"
    visual.Size = punchRadius
    visual.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    visual.Transparency = 1
    visual.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    visual.CanCollide = false
    visual.Anchored = true
    visual.Parent = Workspace

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if isHoldingR then
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                visual.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -punchRadius.Z / 2)
                visual.Transparency = 0.5
            else
                visual.Transparency = 1
            end
        else
            visual.Transparency = 1
        end
    end)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not isHoldingR then return end
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastPunchTime > (minDelay + math.random() * (maxDelay - minDelay)) then
        executePunchWithRadius()
        lastPunchTime = now
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if isHoldingR and frozenPosition then
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = frozenPosition
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(1)
        removeBlur()
    end
end)

local function onCharacter(char)
    task.wait(1)
    hasTriggered = false
    createRadiusVisual()
    removeBlur()

    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    if hum then
        hum.Died:Connect(function()
            rejoinSameServer()
        end)
    end
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    task.spawn(function() onCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character) end)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and not hasTriggered then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum and hrp then
            if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
                rejoinSameServer()
            end
            if hrp.Position.Y < -20 then
                rejoinSameServer()
            end
        end
    end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

getgenv().SilentAim = {
    Enabled = true,
    TargetPart = "Head",
    FOV = 140,
    HitChance = 100,
    TeamCheck = false,
    ShowFOV = true,
    TracerEnabled = true,
}
local FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVCircle.Thickness = 2
FOVCircle.NumSides = 80
FOVCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
FOVCircle.Transparency = 0.75
FOVCircle.Filled = false
FOVCircle.Visible = true

local Tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
Tracer.Thickness = 2
Tracer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
Tracer.Transparency = 0.8
Tracer.Visible = false

local LockedTarget = nil

local function GetClosestPlayer()
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = math.huge

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            if getgenv().SilentAim.TeamCheck and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then continue end

            local part = player.Character:FindFirstChild(getgenv().SilentAim.TargetPart) or player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not part then continue end

            local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if not onScreen then continue end

            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local dist = (mousePos - Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)).Magnitude

            if dist < shortest and dist <= getgenv().SilentAim.FOV then
                shortest = dist
                closest = part
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    
    FOVCircle.Position = mousePos
    FOVCircle.Radius = getgenv().SilentAim.FOV
    FOVCircle.Visible = getgenv().SilentAim.ShowFOV and getgenv().SilentAim.Enabled

    LockedTarget = GetClosestPlayer()
    
    if getgenv().SilentAim.TracerEnabled and LockedTarget and getgenv().SilentAim.Enabled then
        local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(LockedTarget.Position)
        
        if onScreen then
            Tracer.From = mousePos
            Tracer.To = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
            Tracer.Visible = true
        else
            Tracer.Visible = false
        end
    else
        Tracer.Visible = false
    end
end)

local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
local oldIndex = mt.__index
setreadonly(mt, false)

mt.__index = newcclosure(function(self, key)
    if getgenv().SilentAim.Enabled and self == Mouse and key == "Hit" then
        if LockedTarget and math.random(1, 100) <= getgenv().SilentAim.HitChance then
            return CFrame.new(LockedTarget.Position)  -- No Prediction
        end
    end
    return oldIndex(self, key)
end)

setreadonly(mt, true)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then
        getgenv().SilentAim.Enabled = not getgenv().SilentAim.Enabled
        print("Silent Aim:", getgenv().SilentAim.Enabled and "ON" or "OFF")
        
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket then -- ] Increase FOV
        getgenv().SilentAim.FOV = getgenv().SilentAim.FOV + 10
        print("FOV Increased →", getgenv().SilentAim.FOV)
        
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket then -- [ Decrease FOV
        getgenv().SilentAim.FOV = math.max(30, getgenv().SilentAim.FOV - 10)
        print("FOV Decreased →", getgenv().SilentAim.FOV)
    end
end)

print("✅ Silent Aim v2.5 (0 Prediction) Loaded")
print("INSERT = Toggle | [ ] = Adjust FOV")

    local character = player.Character

    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local target = winPads[difficulty]

    if target and target.Parent then
        root.CFrame = target.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
    end
end

    while enabled and gui.Parent do

            end

        else
            status.Text = "Teleporting: " .. selectedDifficulty
            teleport(selectedDifficulty)
            task.wait(interval)
        end
    end

    if gui.Parent then
        status.Text = "Stopped"
    end
end

    else

        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 55, 55)
        status.Text = "Stopped"
    end
end)

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    main.Visible = false
    reopen.Visible = true
end)

-- REOPEN MENU
reopen.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    main.Visible = true
    reopen.Visible = false
end)

scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Settings
local MIN_FOV, MAX_FOV = 40, 120
local fov = 70
local enabled = true
local dragging = false
local menuDragging = false
local alive = true

-- Variables
local connections = {}
local KEYBIND_TOGGLE = Enum.KeyCode.K
local KEYBIND_REMOVE = Enum.KeyCode.Delete
local lastMousePos = nil

local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local defaultFOV = currentCamera and currentCamera.FieldOfView or 70

-- Forward declarations
local setEnabled
local destroyMenu

-- Connection tracking
local function trackConnection(connection)
    table.insert(connections, connection)
    return connection
end

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")

-- Enable / Disable

hint.Text = "[K] Toggle  [Delete] Remove [P] Hide/Unhide"
hint.TextSize = 10
hint.Parent = frame

-- FOV slider
local function setFOVFromX(x)
    local width = track.AbsoluteSize.X
    if width <= 0 then return end

    local alpha = math.clamp(
        (x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / width,
        0, 1
    )

    fov = math.floor(
        MIN_FOV + alpha * (MAX_FOV - MIN_FOV) + 0.5
    )

    knob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
    label.Text = "FOV: " .. fov
end

local function beginSliderDrag(input)
    if not enabled then return end

    dragging = true
    setFOVFromX(input.Position.X)
end

trackConnection(track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        beginSliderDrag(input)
    end
end))

trackConnection(knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        beginSliderDrag(input)
    end
end))

-- Drag menu using title area
trackConnection(title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        menuDragging = true
        lastMousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    end
end))

trackConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        setFOVFromX(input.Position.X)
    end

    if menuDragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then

        local currentPos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

        if lastMousePos then
            local delta = currentPos - lastMousePos

            frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                frame.AbsolutePosition.X + delta.X,
                frame.AbsolutePosition.Y + delta.Y
            )
        end

        lastMousePos = currentPos
    end
end))

trackConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = false
        menuDragging = false
        lastMousePos = nil
    end
end))

-- Toggle
local function updateToggle()
    toggle.Text = enabled and "ON" or "OFF"

    toggle.BackgroundColor3 = enabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(0, 145, 80)
        or Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 90)
end

setEnabled = function(value)
    enabled = value
    updateToggle()

    if not enabled then
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

        if camera then
            camera.FieldOfView = defaultFOV
        end
    end
end

trackConnection(toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
    setEnabled(not enabled)
end))

-- Remove everything and clean up
destroyMenu = function()
    if not alive then return end

    alive = false
    enabled = false

    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("FOVController")

    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    if camera then
        camera.FieldOfView = defaultFOV
    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end

    table.clear(connections)

    gui:Destroy()
end

trackConnection(remove.Activated:Connect(destroyMenu))

trackConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)

        cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("FieldOfView"):Connect(function()

            if not alive or not enabled then return end

            if cam.FieldOfView ~= fov then
                cam.FieldOfView = fov
            end
        end)
    )
end

-- Re-attach watcher if camera changes
trackConnection(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()

    local newCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    if newCamera then
        attachFOVWatcher(newCamera)
    end
end))

-- Attach to initial camera
local initialCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

if initialCamera then
    attachFOVWatcher(initialCamera)
end

-- Enforce FOV every frame
RunService:BindToRenderStep(
    "FOVController",
    Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value,

    function()
        if not alive or not enabled then return end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

        if camera and camera.FieldOfView ~= fov then
            camera.FieldOfView = fov
        end
    end
)

-- ============================================
-- AUTO PARRY BY BACKWOOD
-- v15.0 — Slightly More Aggressive (Controlled)
-- ============================================
local success, err = pcall(function()

for _, name in ipairs({"AutoParryByBackwood", "BWS_ESP", "BWS_Ring", "BWS_TriggerFOV"}) do
	local old = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then old:Destroy() end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

if not getgenv().BWS then getgenv().BWS = {} end

local defaults = {
	Enabled = true,
	PingComp = true,
	ExtraMs = 20,
	FireDebounce = 0.070,
	MaxParryDistance = 43,
	FastBallDistance = 72,
	FastBallSpeed = 70,
	ClashEnabled = true,
	ClashSpeedMult = 1.22,
	ClashMinRate = 0.013,
	ClashMaxRate = 0.085,
	AutoCurve = true,
	CurveDir = "AtTarget",
	CurvePower = 105,
	ShowRing = true,
	BallESP = true,

	TriggerBot = true,

	AutoClicker = false,
	AutoClickerCPS = 80,
}

for k, v in pairs(defaults) do
	if getgenv().BWS[k] == nil then getgenv().BWS[k] = v end
end
local CFG = getgenv().BWS

local State = {
	parriedBalls = {},
	lastParry = 0,
	lastFireTime = 0,
	ballCache = {},
	prevBallVel = {},
	prevBallPos = {},
	velHistory = {},
	clashCount = {},
	inClash = false,
	clashUntil = 0,
	clashRate = 0.05,
	frame = 0,
	globalLock = 0,
	ping = 0.05,
	playerVel = Vector3.zero,
	prevPlayerPos = Vector3.zero,
	blockConns = {},
	lastClashFire = 0,
	triggerHeld = false,
	lastTriggerFire = 0,
	triggerTarget = nil,
	triggerHighlight = nil,

	lastAutoClick = 0,
}

local ESPFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
ESPFolder.Name = "BWS_ESP"
ESPFolder.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local RingFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
RingFolder.Name = "BWS_Ring"
RingFolder.Parent = workspace

local ActiveESP = {}

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1.8)
		pcall(function()
			local stats = game:GetService("Stats")
			local pms = stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
			State.ping = math.clamp(pms / 1000, 0.02, 0.5)
		end)
	end
end)

local function CacheBlock()
	State.blockConns = {}
	local gui = Player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not gui then return end
	local hotbar = gui:FindFirstChild("Hotbar")
	if not hotbar then return end
	local btn = hotbar:FindFirstChild("Block")
	if not btn then return end
	if not getconnections then return end
	pcall(function()
		for _, sig in ipairs({"Activated", "MouseButton1Click", "MouseButton1Down"}) do
			for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(btn[sig])) do
				table.insert(State.blockConns, conn)
			end
		end
	end)
end

task.delay(1.3, CacheBlock)
Player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
	if c.Name == "PlayerGui" then task.delay(1.3, CacheBlock) end
end)

local function RawFire()
	local now = tick()
	if now - State.lastFireTime < CFG.FireDebounce then return false end
	if now < State.globalLock then return false end

	State.lastFireTime = now
	State.globalLock = now + 0.055

	if #State.blockConns > 0 then
		for _, conn in ipairs(State.blockConns) do
			pcall(function() conn:Fire() end)
		end
		return true
	end

	CacheBlock()
	if #State.blockConns > 0 then
		for _, conn in ipairs(State.blockConns) do
			pcall(function() conn:Fire() end)
		end
		return true
	end

	pcall(function()
		VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, true, game, 0)
		VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, game, 0)
	end)
	return true
end

local function DoAutoClick()
	pcall(function()
		VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, true, game, 0)
		VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, game, 0)
	end)
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Four then
		State.autoClickerEnabled = not State.autoClickerEnabled
		print(State.autoClickerEnabled and "[Backwood] AutoClicker ON" or "[Backwood] AutoClicker OFF")
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not CFG.AutoClicker or not State.autoClickerEnabled then return end
	local now = tick()
	local interval = 1 / math.clamp(CFG.AutoClickerCPS, 20, 110)
	if now - State.lastAutoClick >= interval then
		State.lastAutoClick = now
		DoAutoClick()
	end
end)

local function GetTriggerTarget()
	local char = Player.Character
	local HRP = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not HRP then return nil end

	local mode = CFG.TriggerMode
	local mousePos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
	local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local look = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge

	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= Player and p.Character then
			local h = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
			if h and hum and (not CFG.TriggerOnlyAlive or hum.Health > 0) then
				local dist = (HRP.Position - h.Position).Magnitude
				local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(h.Position)

				if mode == "Crosshair" then
					if onScreen then
						local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
						if d < 34 and d < bestScore then
							best, bestScore = p, d
						end
					end
				elseif mode == "FOV" then
					if onScreen then
						local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
						if d <= CFG.TriggerFOV and d < bestScore then
							best, bestScore = p, d
						end
					end
				elseif mode == "Proximity" then
					if dist <= CFG.TriggerRange then
						local toEnemy = (h.Position - camPos)
						local dir = toEnemy.Magnitude > 0.01 and toEnemy.Unit or Vector3.zero
						local dot = look:Dot(dir)
						if dot > 0.28 and dist < bestScore then
							best, bestScore = p, dist
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function TriggerFire()
	local now = tick()
	if now - State.lastTriggerFire < CFG.TriggerDelay then return false end
	if RawFire() then
		State.lastTriggerFire = now
		State.lastParry = now
		return true
	end
	return false
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if CFG.TriggerHoldKey ~= "" then

	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if CFG.TriggerHoldKey ~= "" then
		local ok, code = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[CFG.TriggerHoldKey] end)
		if ok and input.KeyCode == code then State.triggerHeld = false end
	end
end)

local function GetBallVel(ball)
	local z = ball:FindFirstChild("zoomies")
	if z then
		local vv = z:FindFirstChild("VectorVelocity")
		if vv then
			local ok, val = pcall(function()
				if vv:IsA("VectorValue") then return vv.Value end
				if typeof(vv.VectorVelocity) == "Vector3" then return vv.VectorVelocity end
			end)
			if ok and val and typeof(val) == "Vector3" then return val end
		end
	end
	return ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity
end

local function UpdateVelHistory(ball, vel)
	if not State.velHistory[ball] then State.velHistory[ball] = {} end
	local hist = State.velHistory[ball]
	table.insert(hist, 1, vel)
	if #hist > 5 then table.remove(hist) end
end

local function IsCurving(ball)
	local hist = State.velHistory[ball]
	if not hist or #hist < 3 then return false end
	local a, b = hist[1], hist[3]
	if a.Magnitude < 9 or b.Magnitude < 9 then return false end
	return a.Unit:Dot(b.Unit) < 0.83
end

local function IsBall(obj)
	if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	if obj:GetAttribute("realBall") then return true end
	local n = obj.Name:lower()
	if n:find("ball") then
		if (obj:IsA("Part") and obj.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball) or obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function CleanObj(obj)
	State.ballCache[obj] = nil
	State.parriedBalls[obj] = nil
	State.prevBallPos[obj] = nil
	State.prevBallVel[obj] = nil
	State.velHistory[obj] = nil
	State.clashCount[obj] = nil
	if ActiveESP[obj] then
		ActiveESP[obj]:Destroy()
		ActiveESP[obj] = nil
	end
end

local function TrackObj(obj)
	if State.ballCache[obj] then return end
	if not IsBall(obj) then return end
	State.ballCache[obj] = true
	obj.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not obj:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then CleanObj(obj) end
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do pcall(TrackObj, d) end
end)
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj) pcall(TrackObj, obj) end)

local function GetCurveTarget(ball)
	local ballPos = ball.Position
	local ballVel = GetBallVel(ball)
	if ballVel.Magnitude < 1 then return nil end
	local fwd = ballVel.Unit
	local HRP = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local dir = CFG.CurveDir
	local pwr = CFG.CurvePower

	if dir == "AtTarget" and HRP then
		local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= Player and p.Character then
				local h = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
				if h and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					local d = (HRP.Position - h.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestD then bestD = d; best = h end
				end
			end
		end
		if best then return best.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.1, 0) end
		dir = "Up"
	end

	if dir == "Random" then
		dir = ({"Up", "Left", "Right"})[math.random(3)]
	end

	if dir == "Up" then return ballPos + fwd * 52 + Vector3.new(0, pwr, 0)
	elseif dir == "Down" then return ballPos + fwd * 52 + Vector3.new(0, -pwr, 0)
	elseif dir == "Left" then
		local left = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0):Cross(fwd)
		if left.Magnitude > 0.01 then left = left.Unit else left = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
		return ballPos + fwd * 52 + left * pwr
	elseif dir == "Right" then
		local right = fwd:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
		if right.Magnitude > 0.01 then right = right.Unit else right = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
		return ballPos + fwd * 52 + right * pwr
	end
	return ballPos + fwd * 52 + Vector3.new(0, pwr, 0)
end

local function AimAt(worldPos)
	local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
	if onScreen then return sp.X, sp.Y end
	local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
	local center = Vector2.new(vp.X/2, vp.Y/2)
	local d = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center
	if d.Magnitude > 0 then
		local edge = center + d.Unit * math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * 0.45
		return edge.X, edge.Y
	end
	return nil, nil
end

local function Parry(ball, useCurve)
	local now = tick()
	if now < State.globalLock then return false end
	local cd = State.parriedBalls[ball] or 0
	if now < cd then return false end

	if useCurve and CFG.AutoCurve then
		local target = GetCurveTarget(ball)
		if target then
			local cx, cy = AimAt(target)
			local mp = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
			if cx and mousemoveabs then
				pcall(function() mousemoveabs(cx, cy) end)
				RawFire()
				pcall(function() mousemoveabs(mp.X, mp.Y) end)
			else
				RawFire()
			end
		else
			RawFire()
		end
	else
		RawFire()
	end

	State.lastParry = now
	State.parriedBalls[ball] = now + (State.inClash and 0.055 or 0.13)
	return true
end

local function UpdateClashRate(ball, speed, flipped)
	local cd = State.clashCount[ball]
	if not cd then
		cd = {hits = 0, lastFlip = 0}
		State.clashCount[ball] = cd
	end
	if flipped then
		cd.hits = cd.hits + 1
		cd.lastFlip = tick()
	end

	local now = tick()
	local clash = (cd.hits >= 1 and (now - cd.lastFlip) < 2.6) or speed > 82

	if clash then
		State.inClash = true
		State.clashUntil = now + 1.05
		local normalized = math.clamp((speed - 48) / 255, 0, 1)
		local rate = CFG.ClashMaxRate - (CFG.ClashMaxRate - CFG.ClashMinRate) * normalized
		State.clashRate = math.clamp(rate / CFG.ClashSpeedMult, CFG.ClashMinRate, CFG.ClashMaxRate)
	end
	return clash
end

local function IsBallThreateningMe(ball, pPos)
	if CFG.OnlyTargetedAtMe then
		local target = ball:GetAttribute("target")
		if target ~= Player.Name then return false end
	end

	local bPos = ball.Position
	local bVel = GetBallVel(ball)
	local speed = bVel.Magnitude
	if speed < 0.45 then return false end

	local toPlayer = pPos - bPos
	local dist = toPlayer.Magnitude
	if dist < 0.22 then return true, dist, speed, bVel, 1 end

	local toPlayerDir = toPlayer / dist
	local dot = bVel.Unit:Dot(toPlayerDir)
	local curve = IsCurving(ball)
	local minDot = curve and 0.035 or 0.07

	if dot < minDot then return false end

	local maxDist = (speed > CFG.FastBallSpeed) and CFG.FastBallDistance or CFG.MaxParryDistance
	if dist > maxDist then return false end

	return true, dist, speed, bVel, dot
end

local function CalcETA(ball, pPos, pVel)
	local bPos = ball.Position
	local bVel = GetBallVel(ball)
	local relVel = bVel - pVel
	local toP = pPos - bPos
	local dist = toP.Magnitude
	if dist < 0.14 then return 0 end
	local closing = relVel:Dot(toP.Unit)
	if closing <= 0.035 then return 999 end
	return dist / closing
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait()
		if State.inClash and CFG.Enabled and CFG.ClashEnabled then
			local now = tick()
			if now > State.clashUntil then
				State.inClash = false
			else
				local HRP = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if HRP then
					local pPos = HRP.Position
					local hasThreat = false
					for ball in pairs(State.ballCache) do
						if ball and ball.Parent and IsBallThreateningMe(ball, pPos) then
							hasThreat = true
							break
						end
					end
					if hasThreat and (now - State.lastClashFire) >= State.clashRate then
						State.lastClashFire = now
						RawFire()
						State.lastParry = now
					elseif not hasThreat then
						State.inClash = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function MakeESP(ball)
	if ActiveESP[ball] then return end
	local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bg.Adornee = ball
	bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 28)
	bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)
	bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bg.Parent = ESPFolder
	local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
	tl.Name = "Info"
	tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
	tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	tl.TextSize = 11
	tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	ActiveESP[ball] = bg
end

local function UpdateESP(ball, pPos)
	local bg = ActiveESP[ball]
	if not bg then return end
	local tl = bg:FindFirstChild("Info")
	if not tl then return end
	local target = ball:GetAttribute("target")
	local dist = math.floor((pPos - ball.Position).Magnitude)
	local spd = math.floor(GetBallVel(ball).Magnitude)
	if target == Player.Name then
		tl.Text = "⚠ YOU | " .. dist .. " | " .. spd
		tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
	else
		tl.Text = (target or "●") .. " | " .. dist
		tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 170, 220)
	end
end

local RING_SEG = 12
local RingParts = {}
local ringRadius = 10
local ringColor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 200)
local cachedFloorY, lastFloorT = 0, 0
local rayP = RaycastParams.new()
rayP.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function BuildRing()
	for _, p in ipairs(RingParts) do pcall(function() p:Destroy() end) end
	RingParts = {}
	for i = 1, RING_SEG do
		local s = Instance.new("Part")
		s.Anchored = true
		s.CanCollide = false
		s.CanTouch = false
		s.CanQuery = false
		s.CastShadow = false
		s.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.1, 0.35)
		s.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 200)
		s.Transparency = 0.4
		s.Parent = RingFolder
		RingParts[i] = s
	end
end
BuildRing()

local function FloorY(pos)
	local now = tick()
	if now - lastFloorT < 0.35 then return cachedFloorY end
	lastFloorT = now
	local filterList = {Player.Character}
	for _, p in ipairs(RingParts) do filterList[#filterList+1] = p end
	rayP.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterList
	local r = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), rayP)
	cachedFloorY = r and (r.Position.Y + 0.05) or (pos.Y - 3)
	return cachedFloorY
end

local function UpdateRing(hrp, closeDist, state)
	if not CFG.ShowRing or not CFG.Enabled then
		for i = 1, RING_SEG do if RingParts[i] then RingParts[i].Transparency = 1 end end
		return
	end
	local targetR = 2 + 8 * math.clamp(closeDist / 40, 0, 1)
	ringRadius = ringRadius + (targetR - ringRadius) * 0.2
	local tc = state == "clash" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 180)
		or state == "parry" and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 80)
		or state == "danger" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
		or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 200)
	ringColor = ringColor:Lerp(tc, 0.25)
	local fy = FloorY(hrp)
	local segLen = math.max((2 * math.pi * ringRadius) / RING_SEG, 0.4)
	local tr = state == "clash" and 0.08 or state == "parry" and 0.12 or state == "danger" and 0.18 or 0.4
	for i = 1, RING_SEG do
		local a = (i / RING_SEG) * math.pi * 2
		local s = RingParts[i]
		if s then
			s.Size = Vector3.new(segLen, 0.1, 0.35)
			s.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.X + math.cos(a)*ringRadius, fy, hrp.Z + math.sin(a)*ringRadius) * CFrame.Angles(0, -a + math.pi/2, 0)
			s.Color = ringColor
			s.Transparency = tr
		end
	end
end

	fill.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

	local dragging = false
	local function update(i)
		if not dragging then return end
		local r = math.clamp((i.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		local v = math.floor((mn + (mx-mn)*r)/stp + 0.5)*stp
		v = math.clamp(v, mn, mx)
		CFG[key] = v
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(r, 0, 1, 0)
		val.Text = string.format(stp < 1 and "%.3f" or "%d", v)
	end
	bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true; update(i)
		end
	end)
	UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
	end)
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then update(i) end
	end)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	State.frame = State.frame + 1
	local f = State.frame

	if f % 14 == 0 then
		Dot.BackgroundColor3 = State.inClash and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 180)
			or (State.triggerTarget and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 180))
			or (State.autoClickerEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0))
			or (CFG.Enabled and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80))
	end

	local char = Player.Character
	local HRP = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not CFG.Enabled or not HRP then
		if not CFG.Enabled then
			for i = 1, RING_SEG do if RingParts[i] then RingParts[i].Transparency = 1 end end
		end
		return
	end

	local pPos = HRP.Position
	local now = tick()

	if dt > 0 and State.prevPlayerPos ~= Vector3.zero then
		State.playerVel = (pPos - State.prevPlayerPos) / dt
	end
	State.prevPlayerPos = pPos

	if f % 22 == 0 then
		for b, expiry in pairs(State.parriedBalls) do
			if now > expiry then State.parriedBalls[b] = nil end
		end
	end

	local ringState = "idle"
	local closeDist = 999

	for ball in pairs(State.ballCache) do
		if ball and ball.Parent then
			local bPos = ball.Position
			local dist = (pPos - bPos).Magnitude

			if CFG.BallESP and f % 9 == 0 then
				if dist < 190 then
					if not ActiveESP[ball] then MakeESP(ball) end
					UpdateESP(ball, pPos)
				elseif ActiveESP[ball] then
					ActiveESP[ball]:Destroy()
					ActiveESP[ball] = nil
				end
			end

			if dist > 85 then
				State.prevBallVel[ball] = nil
				State.prevBallPos[ball] = nil
				State.velHistory[ball] = nil
			else
				local bVel = GetBallVel(ball)
				local speed = bVel.Magnitude
				if speed < 1 and State.prevBallPos[ball] and dt > 0 then
					bVel = (bPos - State.prevBallPos[ball]) / dt
					speed = bVel.Magnitude
				end
				UpdateVelHistory(ball, bVel)

				local flipped = false
				local prevVel = State.prevBallVel[ball]
				if prevVel and prevVel.Magnitude > 14 and speed > 14 then
					if bVel:Dot(prevVel) / (speed * prevVel.Magnitude) < -0.22 then flipped = true end
				end
				State.prevBallPos[ball] = bPos
				State.prevBallVel[ball] = bVel

				local threat, tDist, tSpeed = IsBallThreateningMe(ball, pPos)
				if threat then
					closeDist = math.min(closeDist, tDist)
					ringState = "danger"
					local isClash = UpdateClashRate(ball, tSpeed, flipped)
					local eta = CalcETA(ball, pPos, State.playerVel)
					local curving = IsCurving(ball)

					local pingSec = CFG.PingComp and State.ping or 0
					local safety = (CFG.ExtraMs or 20) / 1000
					local triggerWindow = pingSec + safety + 0.048
					if tSpeed > 120 then triggerWindow = triggerWindow + 0.022 end
					if tSpeed > 180 then triggerWindow = triggerWindow + 0.028 end
					if curving then triggerWindow = triggerWindow + 0.018 end

					local shouldParry = eta <= triggerWindow
						or tDist < 17
						or (tSpeed > 95 and tDist < 30)
						or (tSpeed > 160 and tDist < 45)
						or (curving and tDist < 34)

					if isClash then
						ringState = "clash"
					elseif shouldParry then
						if Parry(ball, true) then ringState = "parry" end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if CFG.TriggerBot then
		local holdOk = (CFG.TriggerHoldKey == "") or State.triggerHeld
		if holdOk then
			local target = GetTriggerTarget()
			if target ~= State.triggerTarget then
				State.triggerTarget = target
				UpdateTriggerHighlight(target)
			end
			if target then
				TriggerFire()
				ringState = "clash"
			end
		else
			if State.triggerTarget then
				State.triggerTarget = nil
				UpdateTriggerHighlight(nil)
			end
		end
		if f % 4 == 0 then UpdateFOVCircle() end
	else
		FOVCircle.Visible = false
	end

	if State.inClash then ringState = "clash" end
	if (now - State.lastParry) < 0.18 and ringState == "idle" then ringState = "parry" end
	if f % 4 == 0 then UpdateRing(pPos, closeDist, ringState) end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not CFG.Enabled or State.inClash then return end
	local now = tick()
	if now < State.globalLock then return end
	local HRP = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not HRP then return end
	local pPos = HRP.Position

	for ball in pairs(State.ballCache) do
		if ball and ball.Parent and not State.parriedBalls[ball] then
			if ball:GetAttribute("target") == Player.Name then
				local dist = (pPos - ball.Position).Magnitude
				if dist < 15 then
					local bVel = GetBallVel(ball)
					if bVel.Magnitude > 1 then
						local toP = pPos - ball.Position
						if toP.Magnitude > 0.01 and bVel.Unit:Dot(toP.Unit) > 0.06 then
							Parry(ball, true)
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

   }
})


local CharTab = Window:CreateTab("Character", 4483362458)
local MiscTab = Window:CreateTab("Misc", 4483362458)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local walkSpeed = 16
local jumpPower = 50
local tpwalking = false
local tpwalkSpeed = 43
local infJumpEnabled = false
local noclipEnabled = false
local flyEnabled = false
local flySpeed = 60

local function toggleTPWalk(state)
    tpwalking = state
    if not tpwalking then return end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while tpwalking do
            local delta = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
            
            if char and hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                pcall(function()
                    char:TranslateBy(hum.MoveDirection * tpwalkSpeed * delta * 10)
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function toggleFly(state)
    flyEnabled = state
    local char = player.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    
    if not flyEnabled then
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
        return
    end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bv.Parent = hrp
        
        local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
        bg.P = 9e4
        bg.Parent = hrp
        
        while flyEnabled and char and hrp and hum and hum.Parent do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            hum.PlatformStand = true
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
            
            local moveDir = Vector3.zero
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir = moveDir + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir = moveDir - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir = moveDir - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir = moveDir + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
            
            bv.Velocity = moveDir.Magnitude > 0 and (moveDir.Unit * flySpeed) or Vector3.zero
        end
        
        if bv then bv:Destroy() end
        if bg then bg:Destroy() end
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    end)
end

local function applyHeadless()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
        head.Transparency = 1
        head.CanCollide = false
        for _, child in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then
                child.Transparency = 1
            elseif child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("Mesh") then
                child.Scale = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end
        end
    end
end

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if infJumpEnabled then
        local char = player.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if noclipEnabled then
        local char = player.Character
        if char then
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        if walkSpeed ~= 16 then hum.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed end
        if jumpPower ~= 50 then 
            hum.UseJumpPower = true
            hum.JumpPower = jumpPower 
        end
    end
end)

CharTab:CreateToggle({

})

MiscTab:CreateSection("Utilities")

MiscTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Headless (Client)",
   Callback = function()
       applyHeadless()
   end,
})

MiscTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "No dmg Killbricks (Lasers / Lava)",
   Callback = function()
       for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
           if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
               local name = obj.Name:lower()
               if name:find("kill") or name:find("laser") or name:find("lava") or name:find("damage") or (obj:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") and obj.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Really red")) then
                   obj.CanTouch = false
                   obj.Transparency = 0.7
               end
           end
       end
   end,
})

   Name = "Reset Character",
   Callback = function()
       local char = player.Character
       local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
       if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
   end,
})

local function giveGear()
	if destroyed then return end
	local ids = {}
	for _, b in ipairs(boxes) do
		if b.Visible then
			for id in b.Text:gmatch("%d+") do ids[#ids+1] = id end
		end
	end
	if #ids == 0 then
		if not loopEnabled then
			setStatus("Enter at least one valid Gear ID.", Color3.fromRGB(240, 120, 120))
		end
		return
	end
	local remote = findGearRemote()
	if not remote then
		if not loopEnabled then
			setStatus("Gear remote not found.", Color3.fromRGB(240, 120, 120))
		end
		return
	end
	if not loopEnabled then
		setStatus("Requesting " .. #ids .. " gear(s)...", Color3.fromRGB(220, 200, 120))
	end
	local okCount = 0
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		if destroyed then return end
		local ok = pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer("give gear", id) end)
		if ok then okCount += 1 end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	if not loopEnabled then
		if okCount == #ids then
			setStatus("Requested " .. okCount .. " gear(s)!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 150))
		else
			setStatus("Requested " .. okCount .. "/" .. #ids .. " gear(s).", Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 120))

	end

	loopCount = 0

	loopThread = task.spawn(function()
		while loopEnabled and not destroyed do

			loopCount += 1
			if loopEnabled and not destroyed then
				setStatus("Loop #" .. loopCount .. " · next in " .. loopDelay .. "s",

-- ============================================================
-- CONFIG / SERVICES (make sure these exist ABOVE this script)
-- ============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local PURPLE = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 255)
local MAX_DISTANCE = 1000
local FOV_SIZE = 250

-- drawingWorks: only true if Drawing API is available (exploit/executor)
local drawingWorks = pcall(function()
    local t = Drawing.new("Circle")
    t:Remove()
end)

-- ============================================================
-- FOV CIRCLE (single instance — do NOT create twice)
-- ============================================================
local fovCircle = drawingWorks and (function()
    local circle = Drawing.new("Circle")
    circle.Color = PURPLE
    circle.Thickness = 2
    circle.Transparency = 0.8
    circle.Radius = FOV_SIZE
    circle.NumSides = 60
    circle.Filled = false
    circle.ZIndex = 999
    return circle
end)() or nil

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if fovCircle then
        fovCircle.Position = Vector2.new(
            Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
            Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
        )
        fovCircle.Visible = true
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- ESP
-- ============================================================
local function createESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    local distanceText = drawingWorks and Drawing.new("Text") or nil
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

    tracer.Color = PURPLE
    tracer.Thickness = 1.5

    if distanceText then
        distanceText.Color = PURPLE
        distanceText.Size = 14
        distanceText.Center = true
        distanceText.Outline = true
    end

    highlight.FillColor = PURPLE
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.7
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local function setAllVisibility(v)
        tracer.Visible = v
        if distanceText then distanceText.Visible = v end
        highlight.Enabled = v
    end

    local connection
    connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local character = player.Character
        if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not LocalPlayer.Character then
            setAllVisibility(false)
            if not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
                tracer:Remove()
                if distanceText then distanceText:Remove() end
                highlight:Destroy()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
            return
        end

        local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

        if rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and head then
            local headPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            local localRoot = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local distance = localRoot and (rootPart.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0

            if onScreen and distance <= MAX_DISTANCE then
                highlight.Adornee = character
                highlight.Enabled = true
                tracer.From = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                tracer.To = Vector2.new(headPos.X, headPos.Y)
                tracer.Visible = true
                if distanceText then
                    distanceText.Text = "Distance: " .. math.floor(distance)
                    distanceText.Position = Vector2.new(headPos.X, headPos.Y - 20)
                    distanceText.Visible = true
                end
            else
                setAllVisibility(false)
            end
        else
            setAllVisibility(false)
        end
    end)
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do createESP(player) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(createESP)

-- ============================================================
-- AIMBOT LOGIC
-- ============================================================
local function getClosestHead()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    local localRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not localRoot then return nil end

    local centerPos = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local fovSq = FOV_SIZE * FOV_SIZE
    local closestHead = nil
    local closestScreenDist = fovSq

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local head = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local rootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if head and rootPart and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local distance = (rootPart.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if distance <= MAX_DISTANCE then
                    local screenPoint, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local screenPos = Vector2.new(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y)
                        local dist = (screenPos - centerPos).Magnitude
                        if dist < closestScreenDist then
                            closestScreenDist = dist
                            closestHead = head
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closestHead
end

local success, BulletHandler = pcall(function()
    return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ModuleScripts.GunModules.BulletHandler)
end)

if success and BulletHandler and BulletHandler.Fire then
    local oldFire = BulletHandler.Fire
    BulletHandler.Fire = function(p6)
        local closestHead = getClosestHead()
        if closestHead then
            p6.Direction = (closestHead.Position - p6.Origin).Unit
        end
        return oldFire(p6)
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════ build helpers ══════════════════════════════
local function create(className, props, parent)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do
		inst[key] = value
	end
	if parent then
		inst.Parent = parent
	end
	return inst
end

local function corner(inst, radius)
	return create("UICorner", {
		CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius),
		Parent = inst,
	})
end

local function stroke(inst, color, thickness, transparency)
	return create("UIStroke", {
		Color = color or Theme.border,
		Thickness = thickness or 1,
		Transparency = transparency or 0,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		Parent = inst,
	})
end

local function padding(inst, top, right, bottom, left)
	return create("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, top),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, right),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, bottom),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, left),
		Parent = inst,
	})
end

local function tween(inst, seconds, props)
	tweenService:Create(inst, TweenInfo.new(seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

---Safely resolve a UI parent container, avoiding permission blocks.
local function getSafeGuiContainer()
	local container = nil
	if gethui then
		local ok, result = pcall(gethui)
		if ok and result then
			container = result
		end
	end
	if not container then
		container = coreGui
	end
	if not container then
		container = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	end
	return container
end

-- ═════════════════════════════ game logic ═══════════════════════════════
local function getHeroAccentColor(heroName)
	if powersConfig and type(powersConfig.POWERS) == "table" and powersConfig.POWERS[heroName] then
		local cfg = powersConfig.POWERS[heroName]
		if cfg.Accent then return cfg.Accent end
		if cfg.Red then return cfg.Red end
		if cfg.Glow then return cfg.Glow end
	end
	return DEFAULT_ACCENTS[heroName] or Color3.fromRGB(226, 158, 62)
end

local function equipHero(heroName)
	if not heroName or heroName == "" then
		return
	end
	activeHero = heroName

	local equipPowerRemote = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("EquipPower")
	if equipPowerRemote then
		pcall(function()
			equipPowerRemote:FireServer(heroName)
		end)
	end

	pcall(function()
		localPlayer:SetAttribute("PowerOverride", heroName)
	end)
end

	local function applyHeroVisual(heroName, button, hovered)
		local isSelected = (heroName == activeHero)
		local accent = getHeroAccentColor(heroName)
		local label = button:FindFirstChild("Label")

		if isSelected then
			button.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			if label then
				label.TextColor3 = Theme.backdrop
			end
		else
			button.BackgroundColor3 = hovered and Theme.surfaceHover or Theme.surfaceAlt
			if label then
				label.TextColor3 = Theme.text
			end
		end

		local s = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if s then
			s.Color = isSelected and accent or Theme.borderSoft
			s.Transparency = isSelected and 0 or 0.35
		end

		local marker = button:FindFirstChild("Marker")
		if marker then
			marker.BackgroundColor3 = isSelected and Theme.backdrop or accent
			marker.BackgroundTransparency = isSelected and 0.35 or 0.1
		end
	end

	local function refreshHeroList()

		local pool = CATEGORY_MAP[activeCategory] or ALL_HEROES
		local shown = 0

		for heroName, button in pairs(heroButtons) do
			local matchesCategory = table.find(pool, heroName) ~= nil
			local matchesSearch = (query == "") or (heroName:lower():find(query, 1, true) ~= nil)
			local visible = matchesCategory and matchesSearch
			button.Visible = visible
			if visible then
				shown = shown + 1
				applyHeroVisual(heroName, button, false)
			end
		end

		statusLabel.Text = string.upper(activeHero)
		statusAccent.BackgroundColor3 = getHeroAccentColor(activeHero)
		resultCount.Text = shown .. " / " .. #ALL_HEROES
